summary.zh: 查看项目、任务与负责人

description.zh: 查询工作区、项目与任务，创建和更新任务、评论与截止时间。适合把讨论结果直接落成待办。首次连接在浏览器登录 Asana 授权。
description.en: Query workspaces, projects, and tasks, and create or update tasks, comments, and due dates. Good for turning a discussion into tracked work. Sign in to Asana in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Asana 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Asana and authorize on first connect
